subject.title: feat(plugins): upgrade llm_input/llm_output hooks from fire-and-forget to modifying

question: Should the existing `llm_input` and `llm_output` observation hooks be converted into awaited interception hooks, or should blocking and mutation use a separate opt-in API?
rationale: The choice changes a shipped public plugin contract and grants installed plugins new security- and availability-sensitive control over every model call.

options.title: Add separate interception hooks
options.body: Keep the current observation hooks fire-and-forget and introduce explicitly named modifying hooks with bounded execution and documented policy.

options.title: Version the existing hooks
options.body: Adopt modifying semantics only with an explicit migration, deprecation, timeout, ordering, and upgrade-proof plan.

options.title: Accept the timing break
options.body: Intentionally await existing handlers and document that enabled plugins can delay, block, rewrite, or replace model traffic.

recommendation.title: Add separate interception hooks
recommendation.body: Keep the current observation hooks fire-and-forget and introduce explicitly named modifying hooks with bounded execution and documented policy.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent ownership signal spanning both the public hook contract and the affected agent runtime paths.
